message.content:
In a standard poker game, the “highest number of hearts” simply means the player who holds the most hearts in their hand.  
- In Texas Hold’em (5‑card hand) the maximum you can have is 5 hearts.  
- In Seven‑Card Stud (7‑card hand) the maximum is 7 hearts.  

So the player with the most hearts in their hand has the highest number of hearts.
